absences: Hospitals: one search, no 2026 hospital microreactor power agreement found; results were 2022 items and an Army base deal headline with no hospital named.
Disaster relief: DHS S&T solicitation 70RSAT26R00000003 (issued 2025-12-23, offers due 2026-01-09) seeks a microreactor for emergency response; no award found and no MWe figure, so not a record.
Hydrogen / ammonia: no 2026 microreactor deal with an MWe figure found. Only 2026 hydrogen item was a non-nuclear aluminum-water reactor offtake (GH Power, 2026-09-14), out of scope.
Data centers behind the meter: no October 2026 microreactor power agreement found. Results were older deals (Oklo LOIs, TerraPower-Sabey MoU, Kairos-TVA-Google) already on the tab or undated.

Mines: no new 2026 mine-site microreactor deal with an MWe figure found; Radiant-Idaho Strategic (2024) is already shipped. Trade-blog claims of 600 MW of diesel mine capacity are unsourced and not used.

Desalination: no 2026 microreactor desalination deal with a utility found. Desalination deals returned were conventional RO or non-nuclear (ACWA-DEWA Hassyan, 2026-10-28; Veolia-SBM floating units, 2026-01).
District heating beyond Finland: no 2026 sub-10 MWth district-heat microreactor agreement found. Lappeenranta University research reactor mentioned without a thermal rating or date.
Lunar fission surface power: no change found after the 2026-01-13 DOE-NASA announcement; no check issued because shipped text still matches the primary.
Penn State eVinci: no 2026 NRC application or Westinghouse license filing found; NRC advanced reactor rule expected by Sept 2026 per secondary coverage. Shipped text stands.
UIUC Kronos: NRC docketing (2026-05-18) and review kickoff (2026-06-23) are consistent with the shipped 'application' status; no check issued.
Last Energy London Gateway: no 2026 progress found beyond the 2025-09-15 MOU; shipped 2030 target is a plan, not a verified schedule. No verdict possible.
Uvation / Terra Innovatum 1 MWe pilot: still an LOI in every 2026 source found; no primary 2026 company release confirming status. Shipped text stands.
Copper Valley Electric (Valdez): no 2026 CVEA statement found; coverage says the project was dropped on cost grounds, consistent with the shipped 'tabled'.
Regions (Type E): not searched this pass; no new region candidates.
Nucnet Jyvaskyla article returned HTTP 403; Jyvaskyla record relies on Steady Energy and WNN primaries instead.

Wise County, Virginia microreactor feasibility study (Cardinal News, 2026-11-03; public meeting 2026-11-05): a state/county study with no vendor or site named. Web-lead, not a Type S record because it names no buyer load or MWe.

applications.name: Hornbeck Offshore and Deployable Energy Unity maritime MOU
applications.what_it_says: Deployable Energy and Hornbeck Offshore signed a memorandum of understanding on 17 August 2026 to pursue maritime uses of the Unity reactor, which is rated at 1 MWe and is mass-manufactured and transportable. The coverage fetched names no vessel, site or price.
applications.microreactor_read: A 1 MWe block sits at the bottom of the 1-20 MW band and suits a single vessel or offshore platform load. Only an MOU is public, with no load, price or order.

applications.name: Scorpio Tankers and AMPERA floating nuclear power barges
applications.timeline: strategic collaboration announced 2026-04-03; floating barges first, nuclear-powered vessels later
applications.sponsor: Scorpio Tankers ($10 million equity investment in AMPERA)
applications.what_it_says: Scorpio Tankers announced a strategic collaboration with AMPERA on 3 April 2026 and put $10 million into the developer. The companies plan floating nuclear power barges first, with nuclear-powered commercial vessels later. The stated output of 15 to 30 MWe is an expectation, not a design figure.
applications.microreactor_read: A 15-30 MWe unit is above the 1-20 MW band at the top end and sits within it at the bottom. No buyer, port, price or site is named, and the money is equity for early design work.

applications.name: Steady Energy and Alva (Jyväskylä) LDR-50 district-heat study
applications.power_class: 50 MW thermal per LDR-50 reactor (thermal, not electric)
applications.timeline: letter of intent announced 2026-05-19; one-year preliminary study
applications.what_it_says: Steady Energy and Alva, a municipal utility from the city of Jyväskylä in central Finland, signed a letter of intent in May 2026 to investigate the suitability of SMRs as a source for district heating. The LDR-50 is rated at 50 MW thermal. The primary sources fetched do not state how many reactors the city would take.
applications.microreactor_read: The 50 MWth design is heat, so it does not fit the 1-20 MW electric band directly. It is a study-stage letter of intent with no reactor count, price or site named.
